title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In an alternate 2010, the Holy Empire of Britannia has conquered Japan and renamed it Area 11. Lelouch, an exiled Britannian prince seeking revenge for his mother's death and his sister Nunnally's injuries, receives Geass, the power to command anyone through eye contact, and leads a rebellion as the masked Zero. His childhood friend Suzaku chooses to change Britannia from within and opposes Zero's methods. This 8-volume manga adapts the anime with its own changes and drops the mecha.
life_message: Changing an unjust world may demand terrible choices, and the means a person chooses define them.

content.note: Terrorism, military clashes, a kidnapping, hostages, an explosion and an ordered killing; Geass compels people to shoot themselves (ANN review; AniList Terrorism/Military, MU Murder/s).

ANN notes fan-pandering school-comedy scenes (e.g. cat ears); no nudity tags; MangaDex safe.

Mind control used to make people harm themselves; grief and angst over Nunnally (ANN review; MU Mind Control).
Manipulation, gambling and political terrorism by a sympathetic lead (MU Manipulative/Ruthless Protagonist).
Anime tie-in from a large franchise (MU Based on an Anime).

folkways.japan: Occupied Japan and the 'Elevens' frame the story; school-life comedy interludes follow Japanese anime conventions rather than the story's argument.

delivery.evidence: ANN calls angsty monologues about Nunnally heavy-handed but says the Lelouch-Suzaku conflict raises questions instead of easy answers.

personified.ideology: Ends justify the means; violent revolution against empire
Reform from within the system, rejecting terror

delivery.note: One review finds the manga's monologues heavy-handed while its central ideological clash between the two friends is presented with both sides given weight.

winners_losers: Neither side wins cleanly in the summaries: Lelouch's rebellion gains ground at great moral cost, and Suzaku's lawful path is given sympathy; the empire's domination is condemned.
